mechanism_narrative: A sustained 6-month increase in real GDP growth (GDPC1) above 2.5% signals accelerating demand, which boosts corporate earnings expectations and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of accelerating real GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below 98.0 signals weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of declining industrial production.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above 4.5% signals tighter monetary policy, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising federal funds rates above 4.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals labor market weakness, which reduces consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of rising unemployment above 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the housing starts index (HOUST) above 1,500 signals accelerating residential construction activity, which boosts economic growth and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of accelerating housing starts above 1,500.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the CPI inflation index (CPIAUCSL) above 3.5% signals accelerating inflation, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of accelerating inflation above 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the retail sales index (RSAFS) above 750 signals accelerating consumer spending, which boosts corporate earnings and drives positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of accelerating retail sales above 750.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month rise in the payrolls index (PAYEMS) above 160,000 signals accelerating labor market growth, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) during periods of accelerating payrolls above 160,000.
